findings.title: Collapsed workflow rows eagerly render every run's full agent detail
findings.what: The list maps every workflow to an expandable row but unconditionally mounts RunDetail inside that row even when isExpanded is false. RunDetail immediately derives phase aggregates and renders the default PhaseTree, which maps every phase and agent into tables. Initial page cost and DOM size therefore grow with the total agents across all historical runs, rather than with the visible rows or the one expanded run.
findings.fix: Render RunDetail only when isExpanded is true (or lazily mount/cache it after first expansion); for large ledgers, also consider row virtualization or pagination behind a measured budget.
findings.acceptance: Add a test with multiple collapsed runs asserting that no run-phase-tree or agent detail exists before expansion, then expand one row and assert only that run's detail mounts. A render/DOM probe with many runs must show initial mounted agent rows bounded independently of total historical agents.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed isExpanded is computed at src/components/WorkflowList.tsx:423 and passed to PatternFly row wrappers, but RunDetail is unconditional at line 450. The same file shows RunDetail computes phaseAggregates at line 274 and PhaseTree maps phases and AgentTable maps agents at lines 163-188 and 124-126. Existing batch test behavior at src/components/WorkflowList.test.ts:113-135 independently confirms agent detail is present before the collapsed row is expanded; that test is comparison support and is not included in findings[].files.
